title: Tempo Earcheck
user: Instrumentalists choosing practice and ensemble tempos who need to hear, tap, and record a defensible target tempo before they encode it in a score or rehearsal plan.
smallest_useful_product: Offline PWA with tap-tempo, accented-meter click, named tempo trials, and a compact practice card that records a starting BPM, passed BPM, and next step.
constraints: Web Audio works offline; hearing-safe defaults; no copyrighted scores or recordings.
